title: Chicken Curry
description: A warm Indian-inspired dish featuring tender chicken in a rich, flavorful curry sauce.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the curry powder and garam masala, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the coconut milk, tomato paste (if using), salt, and lemon juice.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and cook for 15-20 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened and the chicken is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro (if desired).
